source: The boxes of the VAT return are the English wording of the Belastingdienst's own Explanatory notes to the VAT return 2026 where it gives one (1a to 5b); 5a and 5g, the account names, the statement lines, the journals, the tax codes and the invoice sentences were translated for this pack and have no official standing. See i18n/README.md.
